title: Mauritius Notice of Change of Partner of a Limited Liability Partnership (Form S44(5)-F LLP6)
description: The Corporate and Business Registration Department (CBRD)'s "Notice of Change of Partner", Form S44(5)-F LLP6, prescribed under section 44(5) of the Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2016 and distributed directly and unauthenticated from the Department's own downloadable-forms page (filename `NOTICE-OF-CHANGE-OF-PARTNER_LLP6.pdf`). An already-registered Limited Liability Partnership's partner(s) file this notice to report a partner's appointment and/or cessation of office, identifying the existing record by its category and registered number before stating the affected partner's own particulars and the relevant date(s). This schema does not submit the filing itself; the live source and the Department's own current requirements are always authoritative. GovSchema is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Government of Mauritius or its Corporate and Business Registration Department.

source.documentRef: NOTICE OF CHANGE OF PARTNER (Section 44(5)), Form S44(5)-F LLP6, Corporate and Business Registration Department, 1 page, text-layer PDF (no AcroForm annotations).

verification.notes: See VERIFICATION.md for the full write-up: source fetch/hash, extraction method (positional text-layer extraction plus a canvas render used for box-layout confirmation only), the side-by-side (not stacked) Category/Registered No. identification row that pairs this form structurally with the LP6 sibling rather than the LLP7 sibling, the single combined 'ID No. /BRN' box (a genuinely different pattern from the LLP2 consent-of-partner sibling's own two-box either/or convention), the mutually-exclusive appointment/cessation date fields, and the recurring 'director'-for-'partner' boilerplate defect, here printed above the form's own fields rather than adjacent to the signature block it purports to describe.

steps.title: Section 44(5) — Existing Limited Liability Partnership Identification
Partner Particulars and Date(s) of Change

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Printed side-by-side with registeredNo in a single row of two small bordered boxes beneath the name entry (confirmed independently by each item's own y-position, 3.1 points apart at the same row) — the same side-by-side layout already disclosed on the LP6 sibling (`mu/cbrd/limited-partnership-change-of-general-partner`), a genuine structural pairing between this LLP-Act form and its LP-Act counterpart rather than the stacked layout used by the LLP7/LP7 siblings.

fields.name: registeredNo
fields.label: Registered No.
fields.description: The Limited Liability Partnership's own registered number, used by the Department to positively identify the existing record whose partner is changing. Unlike the LP6 sibling's own equivalent box, which abbreviates this label to 'LP No.', this form prints the fuller 'Registered No.' — the same label used by the LLP7/LP7 siblings, but arranged in this form's own side-by-side (not stacked) layout, a combination not seen on any other CBRD schema in this registry.

fields.name: partnerFullName
fields.label: Full Name of Partner
fields.description: The form prints this label with a single leading asterisk ('*Full name'), referencing a footnote under a 'Note:' heading further down the page — but that heading prints with no body text at all on the live source (confirmed absent in both the text-layer extraction and a supplementary canvas render), the same blank-footnote defect already disclosed on the LP6 sibling. Modelled required regardless, since identifying the affected partner is the substantive purpose of the notice.

fields.name: partnerIdNoOrBrn
fields.label: ID No. /BRN
fields.description: A genuinely different pattern from the LLP2 consent-of-partner sibling's own two separate boxes ('BRN.' and 'ID No.' as distinct either/or fields): this form prints a single combined label, 'ID No. /BRN', over one single bordered box, confirmed by a supplementary canvas render showing exactly one box beneath the combined label with no second box anywhere in the row. Modelled as one field accepting whichever identifier applies (natural-person ID number or body-corporate BRN), matching the source's own single blank rather than inventing a second box the form does not print.

fields.name: dateOfAppointment
fields.label: Date of Appointment
fields.description: Printed with a leading double asterisk ('** Date of appointment'), referencing the same blank 'Note:' footnote as dateOfCessation — see partnerFullName's own description. The form prints no checkbox or other discriminator distinguishing an appointment notice from a cessation notice; in practice exactly one of dateOfAppointment/dateOfCessation applies to a given filing, so both are modelled optional with no requiredWhen gate, the same either/or convention already used on the LP6 sibling's own equivalent fields.

fields.name: dateOfCessation
fields.label: Date Partner Ceased to Hold Office
fields.description: See dateOfAppointment's own description for this field's mutually-exclusive-alternate rationale.
fields.sourceRef: "** Date on which partner ceased to hold office ______"

fields.name: signatureOfPartner
fields.label: Signature of Partner(s)
fields.description: The form prints a single 'Signature of partner(s): ______' line — the plural '(s)' allows for more than one partner to sign. This form also prints the recurring 'If there is more than one director, please attach a separate sheet or sheets with the consent and certificate of the additional director or directors set out in the prescribed format.' boilerplate (the same 'director'-for-'partner' copy-paste artifact already disclosed on this registry's Consent-family and LP6 CBRD schemas), but here it is positioned near the top of the page, directly beneath the section-reference line and above the existing-LLP identification block entirely — before any field capturing a partner's identity, let alone a signature — rather than adjacent to the single signature line it purports to describe, a genuinely more dislocated placement than any prior CBRD sibling's own disclosed instance of this bug. Modelled as one field matching the form's own single printed line, since the form provides no multi-row grid despite the boilerplate's own reference to "additional" signatories.

fields.name: presentedByName
fields.label: Presented By — Name
fields.description: The form's own 'Presented by' block is printed as a two-line run ('Name: ______' plus a second blank continuation line directly beneath it) to accommodate a long filer/firm name; modelled as one field, matching the source's own single logical entry — same convention as every other CBRD schema in this registry.

fields.name: presentedByAddress
fields.label: Presented By — Address
fields.description: Printed as a two-line run for the same reason as presentedByName.

fields.name: presentedByReference
fields.label: Presented By — Reference
fields.description: A filer's own internal file/matter reference, printed as a single optional blank line distinct from the Department's own '(For office use)' column (Officer's Name, Sig, Date) and the header 'FOR OFFICE USE' box (Document Folio, Sheet __ of __), neither of which is modelled.
